evidence_quote: Total bags of feed corn needed = 120 acres/year (cattle) / 1 acre/cow/month = 120 bags for cattle
question_evidence_quote: Additionally, a bag of feed corn can feed each cow for 1 month and each sheep for 2 months.
observed_error: The response converts annual cattle grass acreage into corn bags using an unsupported acreage divisor.
violated_condition: Corn bags must be calculated from animal counts and months requiring corn, using one bag per cow-month.
error_description: The response divides 120 acres of annual cattle grazing demand by an unsupported 1 acre/cow/month and labels the result as bags. This is an invalid conversion, not incorrectly executed division: corn requirements depend on cow-months requiring purchased feed and the stated one-bag-per-cow-month rate.
secondary_errors: The response calculates purchased feed from full-year demand without accounting for the 144 acres of pasture that must be consumed before corn is needed.
